name: Contingency table
description: Compute a contingency table of two or more variables. Optionally compute a chi2 statistic.

functions.name: central_crosstab
functions.description: Create a contingency table showing the relationship between two or more variables

ui_visualizations.name: Contingency table
ui_visualizations.description: Contingency table that shows the relations between the requested variables for all nodes combined.

ui_visualizations.name: Chi-squared test
ui_visualizations.description: Results of the chi-squared test for the contingency table.

arguments.name: results_col
arguments.description: Column to count. Will be used as the columns in the contingency table

arguments.name: group_cols
arguments.description: One or more columns to group by. Will be used as the rows in the contingency table

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Organizations to be included in the analysis

arguments.name: include_chi2
arguments.description: Whether to include the results of a chi-squared statistic test in the results or not. By default, it is included.

arguments.name: include_totals
arguments.description: Whether to include the sums of the rows and columns or not. By default, they are included.

databases.name: Database
databases.description: Database to use for the contingency table

functions.name: partial_crosstab
functions.description: Compute a contingency table for one data station. The shared result includes ranges where values are below a privacy threshold.

ui_visualizations.name: Contingency table
ui_visualizations.description: Partial contingency table that shows the contingency table shared by this node.

arguments.name: results_col
arguments.description: Column to count. Will be used as the columns in the contingency table

arguments.name: group_cols
arguments.description: One or more columns to group by. Will be used as the rows in the contingency table

databases.name: Database
databases.description: Database to use for the contingency table
